title: Design Docs Are All You Need: An AI-native Machine-Learning Performance Tool
abstract: arXiv:2609.05364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine-learning performance modeling is a uniquely hostile terrain for long-lived software: the assumptions baked into today's abstractions are invalidated by tomorrow's models and systems, forcing perpetual refactoring of performance-modeling frameworks. Meanwhile, AI coding agents have become fast and capable enough that regenerating an entire library is cheaper than paying down the tech debt of incrementally patching it. We describe SMART, a rigorous symbolic performance-modeling library for ML systems whose main branch contains almost no code: the repository is a DAG of self-contained natural-language design docs, coding sub-agents regenerate the implementation from only the docs on new version updates, and every human change is a natural-language edit to a doc--self-documenting by construction. Two ingredients make regeneration reliable: (i) a design-doc style built around step-by-step worked examples that act as in-context demon

translated_title: 设计文档就够了：一个AI原生的机器学习性能工具
translated_abstract: 机器学习性能建模对长寿命软件而言是一片极其恶劣的领域：当今抽象中固化的假设会被未来的模型与系统推翻，迫使性能建模框架不断进行重构。与此同时，AI编程代理已经变得足够快速和强大，以至于重新生成整个库比逐步偿还增量修补所积累的技术债务更加划算。我们介绍了SMART，一个面向机器学习系统的严谨符号化性能建模库，其主分支几乎不包含任何代码：该仓库是一个由自包含的自然语言设计文档构成的有向无环图（DAG），当新版本更新到来时，编码子代理仅凭这些文档即可重新生成实现，而人类的每一次修改都是对文档的自然语言编辑——从而在构造上实现自文档化。两个要素保证了重新生成的可靠性：(i) 一种围绕逐步演算实例构建的设计文档风格，这些实例充当上下文内的示范……
tldr: 本文提出SMART，一个AI原生的机器学习性能建模库：其主分支几乎不含代码，仅由自然语言设计文档构成的有向无环图组成，由编码子代理在版本更新时从文档自动重新生成全部实现，人类的修改也只需编辑文档，从而以“整体重新生成”取代“增量修补”，解决了性能建模框架因底层假设频繁失效而需持续重构的难题。
en_tdlr: SMART is an AI-native symbolic performance-modeling library for ML systems whose main branch contains almost no code—instead, the repository is a DAG of self-contained natural-language design docs from which coding sub-agents regenerate the entire implementation on every update, with human changes made only as natural-language doc edits, replacing perpetual refactoring with cheap full regeneration.
